notes.title: Champion of the Arcade (v1.1) is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Extremely shiny news, Isle of Flungo residents... Version 1.1, “Champion of the Arcade,” is out now![/h3]

Here’s a little trailer going over all of the [b]new features[/b], dutifully narrated by our wondrous host Quinston Boff. Full patch notes below!

[previewyoutube=wwdQuUvaH9k;full][/previewyoutube]

At his insistence, here’s a few words from Quinston himself: [i]“A brand-newest, glimmering update has arrived, friend! ...Quickly! Vacuum the download into your computer, and retrieve the slicing-edge content!”[/i]
...Thanks, Quinston.

One last thing - if you’re reading this during the first week of this update’s launch (that’s September 15th - September 22nd), you can grab the game at a [b]25% off discount[/b] to celebrate! Tell your friends! Tell your enemies! Or tell no one!

Enjoy the new stuff!

[b]Version 1.1 patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hard modes[/b] have been added to Burgertron, The Trampoline Act, Gusk City Showdown, and Beast Chase, each with [b]new challenges[/b] and leaderboards
[*] A secret [b]top-tier medal[/b] has been added for all difficulties... Quinston demands perfection!
[/list]
[list]
[*] Touched-up arcade UI elements
[*] Added new Quinston arcade lines
[*] Updated the main menu parallax effect
[*] Added a version number to the chapters screen
[*] A [b]familiar name[/b] has appeared on one of the leaderboards... Can you beat his score?
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the “You” tab not working properly for leaderboards
[*] Fixed the skip prompt not displaying properly in the story credits sequence
[*] Fixed pie chart stat text being incorrect offset under 10%
[*] Fixed point & click SFX playing incorrectly during loading and transitions
[*] Fixed missing font symbol in one of Hugo’s, uh, “going away” scenes
[*] Fixed Knucklenuts car projectiles from being despawned early
[*] Removed an unintended clickable mask from the arcade points bar
[/list]
